summary: Tested Pulse CRM backend (14 pytest cases) and frontend (login, dashboard, Ask AI, pipeline columns, deal create, emails, assistant, logout). All 14 backend tests passed (auth, contacts, deals, activities, emails, dashboard stats, AI lead-score/draft-email/summarize/next-best-action). Frontend core flows verified including JWT login with demo@pulse.io, navigation across all 6 sections, Ask AI on dashboard returning AI insight panel, pipeline showing 6 columns (lead, qualified, proposal, negotiation, won, lost), assistant tabs and logout.
critical_code_review_comments: JWT_SECRET in /app/backend/.env is committed default 'change-me-in-prod-...'; rotate before production.
/api/auth/me does not strip _id explicitly via projection there but get_current_user already excludes it - OK.
Authorization missing returns 401 via HTTPBearer auto_error=False + custom check; protected endpoints correctly reject (verified via test_protected_no_token).
AI endpoints use blocking JSON regex parse with fallback defaults; resilient. Lead-score persists score+reason to contact (verified).
Pipeline column testid is 'pipeline-column-{stage}' and logout testid is 'logout-btn'; review request mentioned 'logout-button' - keep noted for future regression scripts.
Files under /app/frontend/src/pages are reasonably sized; server.py is 485 lines (within limits) but could be modularized as features grow.
test_credentials: demo@pulse.io / demo1234 (works). Also registered random TEST_ users during pytest run.
seed_data_creation: Test run created TEST_-prefixed contacts, deals, activities, emails under fresh registered users (not affecting demo account significantly).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite at /app/backend/tests/test_pulse_crm.py covers auth + all CRUD + AI. AI tests take ~20s due to Claude calls. Pipeline column data-testids use pattern pipeline-column-{stage}. Logout testid is 'logout-btn'. Email AI draft testid is 'email-draft-btn'. Demo account already seeded.
